intro: Elevate your space with the Auraline almirah. Smart shelves, generous hanging space, and a secure drawer with built-in mirror come together to deliver style, function, and unmatched organisation.

features.title: Organise everything with ease
features.text: We know how important it is to keep your space tidy and organised. This almirah offers multiple spacious shelves, giving you ample room to store clothes, accessories, and more.

features.title: Keep valuables safe and secure
features.text: Your peace of mind matters. The secure drawer with a numeric lock ensures your valuables are safely stored, so you can focus on what truly matters.

features.title: Customised hanging rod for convenience
features.text: The hanging rod is thoughtfully placed at an ideal height, making it easier to reach your favourite outfits without hassle.

features.title: Reflect your world effortlessly
features.text: The built-in mirror adds both style and convenience, making it easier to check your outfit while saving space and adding elegance to your almirah.

name: Auraline Women Basic 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror Lavender Gray
